faq.question: How long does an AgotaSoft ERP setup take?
faq.answer: Depending on the size of your business and the number of modules, setup is usually completed within 2-4 weeks, including data migration, user training and integration testing.

faq.question: Can we migrate data from our current system to AgotaSoft?
faq.answer: Yes. We securely migrate your current-account, inventory, invoice and customer data from Excel, your existing ERP/accounting software and other sources. Migration is managed by our expert team.

faq.question: How secure is our data?
faq.answer: Data is transmitted over SSL encryption. How data is processed and stored is explained in our Privacy Policy.

faq.question: Can we turn off the AI features?
faq.answer: Yes. AgotaSoft solutions work in both AI-assisted and classic mode. AI suggestions, automations and smart reporting are entirely optional — you can run the system fully manually if you prefer.

faq.question: Which payment methods do you support?
faq.answer: We accept credit card and bank transfer for monthly or annual subscriptions. Enterprise packages can also be invoiced.

faq.question: How many users can we start with?
faq.answer: You can start with a single user and increase your user count anytime as your business grows. See our pricing page for package details.

faq.question: Do you support Turkish e-invoice (GİB) integration?
faq.answer: In AgotaSoft Bookkeeping, invoices are issued inside the system and each one can be tagged with a document type (e-invoice, e-archive or paper). There is currently no integrator connection that submits invoices directly to GİB.

faq.question: How does support work?
faq.answer: All customers get email and phone support. We provide free training for your team after setup.

faq.question: Is there a free demo or trial period?
faq.answer: Yes, you can request a free demo for any of our products and try the system without entering card details. Trial length ranges from 14-30 days depending on the product.

faq.question: Can we access it from mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, all AgotaSoft products work in a mobile-friendly browser experience; ERP and CRM also offer dedicated mobile apps.

faq.question: Which marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: Trendyol and Hepsiburada. You can connect multiple stores to one account and report on them together or separately.

faq.question: How often is my data updated?
faq.answer: Orders are pulled every 15 minutes, payout and financial records every hour, and listings every 6 hours. When you first connect a store, past orders are imported too.

faq.question: What's the difference between estimated and final profit?
faq.answer: When an order comes in, profit is estimated using your store's commission, shipping rate tier and service fee rules. When the marketplace finalizes the payout, final profit is calculated with the actual deductions; any difference appears on the reconciliation screen.

faq.question: How do I enter product costs?
faq.answer: One by one on the product screen, in bulk with an Excel template, or by uploading your purchase invoice. AI reads the invoice and matches it to your products; no cost is applied until you approve it.

faq.question: Does the AI calculate the numbers itself?
faq.answer: No. All figures come from the profit engine; the assistant only reads and interprets your reports and makes suggestions. Your explicit consent is requested before any data is shared with it.

faq.question: How does the free trial work?
faq.answer: A 14-day trial starts when you sign up, with no card details required. Before the trial ends, you can choose any plan and pay via iyzico.

faq.question: Can I try it without signing up?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the demo on karlilik.net to explore every screen in a store with sample data; demo data resets every night.

faq.question: Do guests need to download an app?
faq.answer: No. When guests scan the table QR code with their phone camera, the menu opens in the browser; they can order, call a waiter and view the bill. There's no sign-up or sign-in, and no name, phone number or email is required.

faq.question: How do I open a business account?
faq.answer: Business accounts are set up by AgotaSoft. Write to us via the contact form or at info@agotasoft.com with your business name, and we'll get in touch to set you up.

faq.question: How are staff accounts created?
faq.answer: From the Users page in the admin panel. Screens are available by role (waiter, cashier, kitchen, manager, owner); the staff app interface is in Turkish.

faq.question: How do the printers work?
faq.answer: Network ESC/POS receipt and kitchen printers are used through the Print Agent running on a computer at the venue. Printers and category routing are set up in the admin panel.

faq.question: What happens if the internet goes down?
faq.answer: The staff app queues waiter orders on the device and sends them once the connection is back; till operations can't be done offline. The guest menu may show the last menu it loaded, but no orders can be placed without a connection.

faq.question: How do I enable online payments?
faq.answer: Each venue works with its own iyzico merchant account, so the money goes directly to the venue's account. The owner enables online payments by entering the iyzico keys on the Settings page of the admin panel.

faq.question: Which languages is the menu shown in?
faq.answer: Menu content is shown in the languages the venue has translated it into; the guest interface is in Turkish and English.
